6.2.rationale: The Indonesian policy explicitly addresses trafficking (TPPO) in the women’s protection chapter: Pasal 44 huruf e states the government must “secara massif dan berkelanjutan mencegah agar tidak terjadi TPPO” (massively and sustainably prevent trafficking in persons). It also defines TPPO (Pasal 24 definisi) and provides integrated services for women victims of violence (Pasal 52–92), which would cover women victims including trafficking-related violence. The judge concluded there were no measures for women trafficking victims, but the available retrieved definition of TPPO plus women-victim service framework and repatriation/reintegration provisions could support a “Yes” depending on indicator intent.
